product.summary: NUFI non-custodial browser-extension wallet for supported blockchain networks and DApps.
product.notes: Selected extension runtime only; NUFI web wallet is a separate interface and deferred.

events.title: NuFi 2.4.x added wallet emulation mode
events.description: NuFi documented releases 2.4.0 and 2.4.2 adding Flint and Phantom wallet emulation mode to the browser extension, providing a dated lifecycle record for extension maintenance.

events.title: NuFi documented Bitcoin address-type support
events.description: NuFi documented support for Bitcoin accounts using multiple derivation-path categories and Native SegWit, Taproot, and legacy-compatible address formats in its first-party Bitcoin address-types guide.

evidence.title: Create or restore a wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party support explicitly distinguishes NUFI browser-extension and web-wallet interfaces and describes both as non-custodial.

evidence.title: NuFi changelog
evidence.notes: First-party NuFi changelog records releases 2.4.0/2.4.2 on 2022-10-11 and describes browser-extension wallet emulation mode.

evidence.title: Bitcoin address types
evidence.notes: First-party NuFi guide documents supported Bitcoin derivation-path categories and address formats; event date uses the documented article modification date as discovery basis.
